title: Repoint alchemy-cli formula to release tarballs
description: The tap's Formula/alchemy-cli.rb installs cli/alchemy.mjs from the alchemy repo's main branch (git url) because no release ships the CLI yet. At the next alchemy release, repoint url to the release source tarball with a sha256 so installs are pinned and reproducible. Tap clone: $(brew --repository)/Library/Taps/thrashr888/homebrew-tap.

title: Review and enable marketplace plugins
description:
The following plugin marketplaces have been configured for this project:

- beads-marketplace
- allbeads-marketplace
- claude-plugins-official-marketplace
- claude-code-marketplace
- skills-marketplace
- chrome-devtools-mcp-marketplace
- claude-skill-marketplace
- repomix-marketplace
- prose-marketplace

Consider which plugins would be useful for your workflow and enable them:

```bash
# List available plugins
claude plugin marketplace list

# Enable a plugin
claude plugin enable <plugin>@<marketplace>
```

Note: beads and allbeads plugins are enabled by default.
